title: Readiness and identity
settles: the stack is the real, non-fixture, authenticated one

steps.name: served bundle has no fixture adapter (disk scan + HTTP scan)
gateway is the live non-fixture build and the kernel is ready
unauthenticated browser sees the LoginScreen (live source label)
operator signs in through the LoginScreen; identity is the gateway-verified one
the browser loaded only live-adapter scripts (no fixture adapter at runtime)

title: Template to preflight to commit
settles: a case exists in the kernel because the UI committed it

steps.name: home offers Design case; the picker lists the published templates
select template, fill parameters; submit stays disabled before preflight
preflight passes with a digest; only then is submit enabled
editing a parameter invalidates the preflight and disables submit again
durable: commit writes case_created + item_enabled to the new case's case-events.jsonl and its plan.json
UI: the panel closes and the new case's world is the one shown

title: Horizon standing
settles: the UI shows the case's real standing, not an invented one

steps.name: durable: the kernel's own files say task_prepare is enabled and the rest are pending
UI: the world shows exactly the plan's items, each with the standing the durable fold implies
UI: a pending item says why it waits; the ready one says it is ready
UI: only the enabled item offers Execute (role-filtered, standing-driven)
a real pointer click focuses the item and the outline lists it with its standing and Execute

title: Discretionary add
settles: an operator-proposed item is durably in the plan with its proposer, and the UI shows it

steps.name: the anchor item offers 'Add discretionary work'; clicking it opens the drawer with the operator as proposer
an empty proposal is refused client-side with no durable effect
durable: submitting writes exactly one plan_mutated (actor operator_local) and a plan item with proposed_by
UI: the drawer reports the kernel's acceptance and still names the operator as proposer
UI: the proposed item arrives in the world through the live stream (no reload), waiting on its anchor

title: Execute through the UI
settles: an executed item is durably active, settled and completed, and its downstream unlocks over SSE without a reload

steps.name: precondition: sentry-gated downstream is blocked; Execute is offered only on the enabled item
UI: Execute chip opens the judgment panel offering exactly Execute (not discretionary work); confirming sends the intent
durable: item_activated, settlement_recorded (accepted), item_completed, then item_enabled for the downstream item
durable: the run's own trace shows authority, workspace, captured artifact and no command events; settlement.json accepted
UI: pill settles and the downstream item unlocks with no reload, no snapshot refetch, no fake progress

title: Sign-off: operator denied, R-SO approves in a separate session
settles: an approval opened by the operator's execution is resolved only by a distinct R-SO principal, with both principals visible in the durable record

steps.name: guard: the operator and the R-SO drive distinct agent-browser sessions
operator designs a sign-off case through the UI; the kernel parks the human gate and enables the draft
operator executes the draft; the kernel escalates it and opens a pending approval requested for this case
operator is denied: no Approve/Reject is offered and an approve intent posted anyway is refused, durable state unchanged
guard: after both sign in, the two sessions hold different cookies and different principals
R-SO (separate session) sees the same case with Approve/Reject on the draft; Approve without a reason is stopped in the panel
durable: R-SO approves with a reason; approvals.jsonl shows the request and a decision by rso_local
durable: the kernel records the resolution in the case ledger under rso_local; and the case trace gains nothing it did not emit
UI: both sessions follow the approval over the stream with no reload; the decision is no longer offered

title: Settlement and the evidence dock
settles: a settled item's captured artifact opens in the dock with a verified digest, and only the needed renderer chunk is fetched

steps.name: durable: SettlementRecorded (accepted), the run's settlement.json, and the stored artifact bytes match the evidence journal
UI: a fresh page load of the case shows the settled standing at once (no stream event needed)
UI: pill -> execution panel lists the captured artifact as evidence, bound by the snapshot (not invented)
UI: opening the evidence resolves it through artifact.get; the dock shows the digest of the stored bytes
network: the HAR shows artifact.get once and ONLY the needed renderer chunk (VAR-006)

title: Lifecycle: close, reopen, terminate
settles: a case closes when its work completes, reopens with a reason, and a second case is terminated with a reason, all as durable kernel events offered only by the snapshot

steps.name: case A is active: the snapshot offers Terminate and not Reopen, on the Core only
durable: executing the last item completes it, achieves the milestone and appends case_closed; case.json is completed
UI: with no reload the Core now offers Reopen and no longer offers Terminate
durable: Reopen needs a reason in the panel; case_reopened is appended carrying it and by whom; case.json is active again
UI: after the reopen the Core offers Terminate again and not Reopen
durable: the operator completes the sign-off human task with a justification; human_task_completed is appended
durable: Terminate on case B needs a reason; case_terminated carries it; case.json is terminated
UI: the terminated case offers Reopen only, and no work can be executed or approved on it

title: Thoth ask narration: interrupt and resume
settles: a typed question is answered by the real kernel, narrated from the returned disclosure only, interruptible and resumable without a second ask

steps.name: the live app offers narration (agent available) and is not the scripted local agent
ask a typed question; the real kernel answers and the disclosure card shows the returned fields
durable: the kernel committed the question and disclosure to the thoth-asks ledger as operator_local, via a delegated ask
interrupt: Space pauses at a checkpoint and the narration does not advance
resume: continue picks up from the checkpoint and finishes without asking again
a free-text question is answered honestly as unsupported and asks nothing
a different principal (R-SO, separate session) gets the kernel's governed denial, recorded under rso_local

title: L0-L8 in one session: console and errors stay empty
settles: the whole live ladder ran in one continuous session per user with no error-level console output and no page error

steps.name: continuity: the operator session is the L0 sign-in's (same cookie), the gateway logged exactly one sign-in per user
durable: the one lifecycle L0-L8 drove is all in the kernel's files (create, mutate, execute, settle, sign-off, close, reopen, terminate, ask)
positive control: the operator session's console capture sees the app's own warning when its stream drops
strict: operator session, agent-browser console and errors are empty of errors for the whole run
strict: rso session, agent-browser console and errors are empty of errors for the whole run

title: Recovery: corrupt artifact, SSE drop, kernel and gateway kill -9
settles: the UI is honest and consistent with the durable files across a corrupt artifact, an SSE drop and kernel/gateway crashes

steps.name: setup: design case R1 through the UI and execute its first item; the artifact is captured
(a) corrupt artifact: bytes edited inside the cell -> typed digest-mismatch card, nothing rendered from the bad bytes; restored afterwards
(d) SSE drop: while the stream is down another session executes; the pill says Reconnecting (no progress), then resumes from the cursor with no duplicate revision
(c) kernel kill -9 and restart: cases recover from disk, the gateway re-subscribes, the next execution reaches the UI over SSE
(b) gateway kill -9 and restart: the UI shows Reconnecting, sessions are gone by design, a fresh sign-in shows exactly the durable state with no duplicate revision
